sections.heading: Behavior, submission and cleanup
paragraphs: Use form-range around one labelled form-range-input; every matching wrapper auto-initializes on document ready.
The wrapper receives --trm-range-fill as a ratio, not a percentage. Native bounds supply 0/100 when absent; min>=max makes the adapter ratio zero.
After assigning input.value, call update(). Construction/update and native input/change paths emit changed on the actual input, even when unchanged; it is not a cancelable mutation gate.
Formatter text uses textContent for the bubble only. Tick labels read option.label without formatter; datalist points are snapshotted once, sorted and clamped to positions.
The bubble and ticks are aria-hidden. Native name/value submit the numeric value; formatter does not create aria-valuetext or convert submitted units.

Pinned track gradient is to right and bubble uses left even in RTL; test native thumb versus decoration rather than claiming direction-aware fill. dispose removes generated bubble/ticks/listeners but retains the wrapper fill property.

formsGuides.description: Give advisory segmented feedback without claiming to measure real-world security.
formsGuides.lead: Give advisory segmented feedback without claiming to measure real-world security.

sections.heading: Overview
Additional example
Behavior, submission and cleanup
paragraphs: Use explicit data-trm-input or a single password field per parent; the text feedback is the first strength-text in the meter parent, not an arbitrary global target.
Default scoring uses eight length/category points. Zero maps to null; thresholds [2,4,6] are inclusive ceilings. This heuristic is not authentication policy or a compromised-password check.
strengthChange is dispatched only when the level changes. Different scores within the same level do not refresh text or dispatch a new plugin event. Event password is redacted as *** or empty.

Nested messages/weights replace their default objects rather than deep-merging. Supply all keys; missing weight keys can yield NaN and an accidental strong result. Validate custom scorer outputs and thresholds separately.
A custom scorer is called only for nonempty text. minLength affects scoring, not native minlength or form validity. evaluate() is needed after programmatic value changes.

There is no numeric ARIA meter. Decorative aria-hidden segments/bar and an associated readable polite status are application markup; dispose removes owned input listeners but leaves the displayed DOM/state.

paragraphs: Put data-trm-toggle=combobox on a named native trigger, include combobox-value, and follow it with the actual Menu. The wrapper form-field is a layout helper, not an invented combobox CSS class.

Author labelled listbox/options and a separate labelled search input. Options receive real focus, not aria-activedescendant tracking. The pin binds any supplied search input even if search=false, and does not generate one from search=true.

Set data-trm-name for a generated hidden input. Single mode stores an identifier; multiple mode joins identifiers with commas. Validate delimiter-sensitive values and native form reset/disabled policies in your application.

sections.heading: Events and completion
paragraphs: The known owned-Menu registry notice is preserved. Combobox shown/hidden and returned promises do not await Menu transitions; observe shown.trm.menu/hidden.trm.menu for settled state.

Events expose value/item directly, not event.detail. change is post-mutation; only show/hide are read as cancellation gates. Outside dismissal may occur through Menu without Combobox hide/hidden notifications.
Use native disabled options; filtering can count their text while keyboard navigation excludes them. Group labels/no-results elements are authored, not generated or automatically regrouped.
Combobox has no own configurable Sass token map. It reuses form-control and Menu tokens; the sibling Menu rule sets max height 300px. The copied focus/contrast CSS is a demo choice, not a core patch.

sections.heading: Behavior, submission and cleanup
paragraphs: Use a labelled type=text field, not a second native type=date popup. ISO preselection is an array, while named text-input submission is formatted display text.

getSelectedDates() returns a copy. setSelectedDates() updates display but does not dispatch adapter change or native input/change. Calendar Pro replaces an inline child field; the example uses a sibling field and a disclosed click-change handler instead. Sync that field explicitly after API calls.
Manual text edits after initialization do not automatically resync the selection array. Supply an explicit application parse/validation policy or use a native date input where appropriate.

Popup visibility callbacks and promises do not establish focus restoration or async animation completion. Inline mode remains visible; disposal destroys the calendar, observer and owned outside handlers.
vcpOptions is spread before adapter-owned configuration: only the months extension is enabled, callbacks/settings can be overwritten, and sanitizer enforcement stays mandatory.
Keep the approved Calendar HTML sanitizer and same-origin dist/icons/datepicker-chevron.svg relative to dist/css. Never weaken Trusted Types/CSP to make a sample render.

The explicit contrast wrapper styles are application choices, including a Calendar Pro styles class for body-appended popups. Parent CSS inheritance alone cannot reach those popups. An explicit demo-only hidden-popup display rule prevents stale desktop coordinates from creating mobile resize overflow.

strength.description: Give advisory segmented feedback without claiming to measure real-world security.
strength.lead: Give advisory segmented feedback without claiming to measure real-world security.

sections.heading: Overview
Additional example
Behavior, submission and cleanup
paragraphs: Use explicit data-trm-input or a single password field per parent; the text feedback is the first strength-text in the meter parent, not an arbitrary global target.
Default scoring uses eight length/category points. Zero maps to null; thresholds [2,4,6] are inclusive ceilings. This heuristic is not authentication policy or a compromised-password check.
strengthChange is dispatched only when the level changes. Different scores within the same level do not refresh text or dispatch a new plugin event. Event password is redacted as *** or empty.

Nested messages/weights replace their default objects rather than deep-merging. Supply all keys; missing weight keys can yield NaN and an accidental strong result. Validate custom scorer outputs and thresholds separately.
A custom scorer is called only for nonempty text. minLength affects scoring, not native minlength or form validity. evaluate() is needed after programmatic value changes.

There is no numeric ARIA meter. Decorative aria-hidden segments/bar and an associated readable polite status are application markup; dispose removes owned input listeners but leaves the displayed DOM/state.
